namespace.description: Namespace embedded in each measurement description on the RIPE Atlas API. Used to distinguish measurements across Terraform states or workspaces. Defaults to "terraform-provider-ripe-atlas".

snapshot.description: Path to a pre-fetched probe snapshot JSON file. When set, probes are read directly from this file with no freshness check. Falls back to RIPE_ATLAS_SNAPSHOT env var. Mutually exclusive with snapshot_cache_path.

snapshotCachePath.description: Path for the auto-managed probe cache file. When snapshot is not set, probes are served from this cache and refreshed from the RIPE Atlas API when stale. Defaults to /tmp/atlasctl-probes.json.

snapshotTtl.description: Maximum age of the cached probe list before it is refreshed from the RIPE Atlas API. Go duration string (e.g. "2h", "30m"). Only applies when snapshot is not set. Defaults to 2h0m0s.

dailyCredits.description: Projected RIPE Atlas credit burn per day for this cohort.

excludeProbeIds.description: Set of probe IDs never selected in this cohort.

hourlyCredits.description: Projected RIPE Atlas credit burn per hour for this cohort.

includeProbeIds.description: Set of probe IDs always included in the cohort. Pinned probes bypass tag exclusions, H3 cell caps, and inter-cohort drawdown. The only reason a pinned probe is skipped is if it is absent from the snapshot.

intervalSeconds.description: Measurement interval in seconds. Minimum `60`.

maxProbesPerCell.description: Maximum probes per H3 geographic cell.

msmId.description: RIPE Atlas measurement ID assigned to this cohort.

probeIds.description: Probe IDs selected for this cohort.

asn.description: Map of ASN (string key) to score bonus.

cities.description: City clusters with scoring bonuses and H3 cell density coefficients for probes within their radius.

countries.description: Map of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to score bonus.

disableContinentalShuffle.description: Disable round-robin continental zone interleaving within band tiers. Default false (shuffle enabled).

excludeTags.description: Probe tags that hard-exclude a probe from this cohort.

h3Resolution.description: H3 cell resolution for geographic diversity (1–15, default 3).

stability.description:
Map of RIPE Atlas stability tag to score bonus.

Additive scoring weights apply on top of each probe's base score of 1. A probe matching multiple criteria accumulates all matching scores.

tags.description: Map of probe tag string to score bonus.

densityCoefficient.description: H3 cell capacity multiplier for probes within this city. Values > 1 relax the per-cell limit; values < 1 tighten it.

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometers within which probes are considered part of this city.

score.description: Additive scoring bonus for probes within radius_km. 0 means no bonus.
